lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The FBI caught a billion-dollar dark web boss by faking a lovers' fight. In a library.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: October 2013. Ross Ulbricht, the man behind the Silk Road, is working in the science fiction section of a San Francisco library.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His laptop holds everything. But if it closes, it's encrypted, and the evidence is gone.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So two agents start a loud argument right behind him. He turns around.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In that one second, another agent slides the open laptop away. Logged in. Game over.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Moral of the story: always lock your laptop.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The full story is on Unfiled Films.
